stem.text: A train on a mountain railway is carrying 200 people of average mass $70\,\text{kg}$ up a slope at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal and at a speed of $6.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The train itself has a mass of $80\,000\,\text{kg}$. The percentage of the power from the engine which is used to raise the passengers and the train is 40%.
What is the power of the engine?
